body:
Local CPU LoRA fine-tune (20 steps, lora_r=4, max_length=32) on 466-record Emily operational corpus (colab preset).

Loss trajectory: 6.4042 → 5.7344 → 5.8189 (step 1/10/20). 34.6 min on CPU.

ENTROPY COMPARISON (64 tokens, greedy, EOS seed):
  Base GPT-2:      H_mean=4.4877 nats  H_max=8.6231 nats
  Fine-tuned (20s): H_mean=4.6602 nats  H_max=8.6346 nats
  Delta:           +0.1725 nats mean  +0.0115 nats max

Interpretation: 20 steps of Emily domain text slightly increases entropy (model is less certain — distributes probability more broadly across EINHORN vocabulary). Full 3-epoch Colab T4 run expected to show larger shift.

Pipeline validated end-to-end: build-dataset → train → convert → gpt2_run --entropy-stats.
Commits: gpt2-alpine-c 4ab6bf0 (entropy fix), a335afc (corpus preset).
Next: S26-04 full run on Colab T4 via emily train upload + notebook.
title: S26-04 smoke test: fine-tune pipeline validated + entropy comparison published
